description: This file defines constants, data classes, and functions related to launching and handling assistant requests in an Android application, specifically for the 'openclaw' app. It includes intent action handling and parsing logic.

classes.name: HomeDestination
classes.description: An enum representing different destinations or sections within the app's home interface.

classes.name: AssistantLaunchRequest
classes.description: A data class encapsulating information about a request to launch the assistant, including source, prompt, and autoSend flag.

methods.name: parseAssistantLaunchIntent
methods.description: A function that interprets an Android Intent to produce an AssistantLaunchRequest object, based on its action and extras.
